checks.claim: The endpoint radius is attached to the exact stored step.y_new, since the real represented blend evaluates to it at theta=1 and both endpoint accessors copy it.
The residual is evaluated over the real polynomial enclosure; the full tube is used for the logarithmic norm. Signed comparison transport closes the tube and preserves endpoint inheritance.
The Gray-Scott reaction symmetric part retains both offdiagonal terms, and the symmetric periodic diffusion is negative semidefinite, including duplicate neighbors on grid=2.
Factory-owned callbacks/constants/grid and crate-private provider capability bind the certificate to the generated model.
Candidate, full tube and all due outputs are staged before visible state/radius/output commit; rejected attempted work is retained.
Requested physical-time output intervals enclose the real polynomial; returned binary64-center displacement is included.
The Gray-Scott fused stencils preserve original scalar order while eliminating two temporary Laplacian vectors per RHS or JVP callback; no elapsed-speed conclusion follows.

scope_limits.detail: A run enforces atol at requested output times and atol/2 for the real continuous curve. A later standalone segment.evaluate(t) query returns a rounded-center radius without enforcing the original run budget; callers must check it.
Generic means the shared driver over the three admitted immutable model families; arbitrary OdeProblem callbacks are typed unsupported. Pure-relative verification is not implemented.
Natural interval residual dependency and fixed tube schedule can require very small steps. Neither broad production readiness nor measured speedup follows from these focused tests.
